capabilities: Search notes by meaning, keyword, or pattern
Answer questions with numbered citations to source passages
Attach notes to chat as focused context
Save answers back to the vault as notes
Serve vault search and reading to external AI clients over MCP
disambiguation: Not a tool for creating links between notes; it searches notes by meaning and answers questions about them.
extras: Desktop only, no mobile support. Search, chat, indexing and MCP are free; a one-time Pro license adds unlimited chat history and history management. Model usage is billed separately by cloud providers, and a local index does not mean all processing stays local.
problem: Notes accumulate but are hard to reuse: finding a half-remembered idea or gathering context for a project means searching and pasting notes by hand.

relations.evidence: Compatible AI clients can search and read your vault through Semlink's tools
connect local models through runtimes such as Ollama

requires.name: Cloud chat and embedding provider API keys
Local model runtime such as Ollama

summary: AI chat and semantic search sidebar that finds related notes, answers with numbered citations, and saves answers back as notes.
